What you worked out by the end of trial 1:
  [1] Patch map: upper cyan r4-8 c9-13, green r5-9 c16-20, lower cyan r11-15 c6-10, west cyan r6-9 c2-5, purple r12-14 c13-15, yellow r13-15 c18-20. East wall is col 22.
  [2] The orchard is stripped bare by about t100. Every patch was dead by t112, so most points must come early.
  [3] Green and cyan ripe pay about 1 each. Unripe and over-ripe pay much less, and yellow ripe pays only 0.25.
  [4] Trees start unripe. Walking over unripe apples wastes them, so path around them.
  [5] Keep 3 or more apples hanging in a patch so eaten cells regrow. A patch eaten bare is dead for the rest of the trial.
  [6] Cells whose apple rotted regrow by themselves. Leaving over-ripe apples to rot is fine; eating them pays little.
  [7] B strips cyan patches bare, especially lower cyan. C eats purple and lower cyan over-ripe. B, C and E crowd yellow.
  [8] Green was less contested early. It still got stripped by others around t60 while I was away.
  [9] I wasted steps travelling between contested patches. Better to pick one good patch and stay there guarding it.
  [10] Zapping costs me nothing and removes a rival for 12+ steps. Use it on agents stripping my patch before the damage is done.

  [11] Go straight to green at the start, eat ripe only, keep 4+ apples hanging, and stay to farm the regrowth.
  [12] Zap any agent that enters green and lines up in my beam, early rather than after it strips the patch.
  [13] Test purple ripe once early, before C eats it over-ripe, to learn its value.

lessons: Map: big cyan r5-9 c1-5, NE cyan r4-8 c9-13, south cyan r11-12 c7-9, purple r12-14 c13-14, yellow r13-15 c18-20, green r7-9 c16-20.
Spawns vary: T1 I spawned near big cyan, T2 at (0,18) near green, and A spawned beside me there.
Every patch is contested. A and B go to NE cyan early, C goes to green and yellow, and all rivals end at south cyan late.
Cyan ripe is my best earner (1 each). Cyan unripe pays half. Green ripe, yellow over-ripe and purple over-ripe pay about 1 but are gone by t30-50.
Far patches (green, yellow, purple) are stripped bare by about t30-50 and never regrow. All patches are bare by about t110-144.
Front-load eating: grab any ripe apple early rather than waiting. Waiting for ripening near rivals lost apples to them.
Idling near rivals gets me zapped (B zapped me 3x in T2, A once). Zaps cost me about 20 steps each time. Keep moving, and keep 3+ cells from rivals or face them.
Rotted cells regrow in about 4 steps regardless of neighbours. A lone over-ripe apple in a bare patch is worth letting rot.
Guarding unripe apples with rivals near fails. Only wait when alone.
Late trial: search rotted-cell regrowth and leftovers far from the rivals' cluster at south/NE cyan.
I only got about 7-9 apples per trial. Rivals eat faster, so I need to take apples on the move, not plan elaborate farms.
todo: At start, eat the nearest ripe or over-ripe apples right away, whatever colour, before rivals strip them.
Zap a rival first when it is adjacent and facing into my beam at a contested patch, instead of standing still.
Try farming a quiet patch such as purple or yellow by eating only 1-2 edges and leaving the rest, to test whether regrowth happens there.
Track where cells rot late in the trial and be there for the unripe regrowth as it ripens.
